_comment: Reference scores for weekly_check.py drift alarms — update when a deliberate change moves them (2026-11-24, params v1-5e0f894b: no grade at a cut inside a reading gap, #424, and every replay scored only where the readings show the meter (EVAL_CLEAN): cycles whose end was seen, cuts outside a gap. Earlier values: 2026-10-20, v1-c13c3f81, 5h median 3.59 / 7d mean 8.18 over the history of then; the same store with the old rule and the clean cases gives 3.29 / 12.12, the store having grown harder weekly cycles since). Each window is judged by its headline error (headline_key): the median on 5h, the mean on 7d, whose median is ~1 pp for every model.
